name: focused-measurement-delivery
goal: Deliver concise screenshot cards and retain page screenshots and runtime measurements through identical-tree main landing, with original provenance.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Current page delivery shows missing runtime figures after a source-identical squash. entityShown only accepts a green point whose commit exactly equals the selected commit, unlike focused screenshot selection. Original green measurements exist and their provenance must remain unchanged.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The standard entity-shown summary test covered record figures but not focused observations or the original, identical prepared tree, identical projected tree, changed tree and unknown tree lifecycle. Extend that existing matrix with an explicit no-full-verdict and original-provenance assertion. No one-off test file is needed.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Record cfe0757be35505c503a6f1d1d89acd1b2acef0052466ac12f7c5567b4989344a at cd9e8e9510d8d7418059c9fc4eba83d36fd2d99e fails exactly the two identical-tree measurement assertions in the standard summary matrix. The remaining original/changed/unknown cases pass. All projection, header, Settings and category browser cases pass, retaining 177 original PNGs and 406 observations.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Use the same complete-tree identity predicate as focused images for green observations. Accept the original commit, the verified opaque sourceTree or legacy prepared side identity; preserve each original testedRevision and keep the full-verdict record independent. The standard summary matrix and an isolated original-predicate mutation guard reject recurrence.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: entityShown now selects focused observations by original commit or identical complete tree. The public record remains full-verification only. Its owning contract and Harness guidance state the rule; all nine summary cases pass without changing the committed test.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Record 3bcc5e802fe2ec99d755e01a4628eeaa1d26a13d22683687a63381be293e89bf at 394aa9b2cdbe98fa06a45a59685b16183fcd562d passes the unchanged paired command: 27 projection/summary/render cases and 17 browser cases across Settings, responsive previews and every entity kind. It retains 177 unit-scoped PNG entries (168 original files) and 406 observations. All original hashes and dimensions reload from Git.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: At 394aa9b2cdbe98fa06a45a59685b16183fcd562d, isolated restorations of the original commit-only measurement filter, cache-side forwarding and capture header each fail their unchanged normal tests; restoring each repair passes. Exact source, assertion and logs are retained for all three.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
steps.evidence: At 394aa9b2cdbe98fa06a45a59685b16183fcd562d, all 628 Reports tests, types, lint, build and audits pass, alongside root format/types/lint/audit and registry checks. Earlier unchanged transport suites and full repository stages retain their original source labels. The actual Settings comparison at this captured source is inspected at 1440, 920 and 390px: both images decode, the two header items are absent, all four profile rows have numbers, Enter opens the viewer, and browser errors/overflow are absent. Parent main 9fb0505e also reloads all three Settings images and six observations from an identical complete tree. This complete loop consolidates the earlier unmerged header/projection loop, whose original red/fix source and proofs remain archived; unfinished duplicate loop metadata is omitted from delivery. Final delivery still requires an unchanged-tree capture and actual remote main verification.

steps.title: Record intentional helper definition updates and verify the root ownership guard.
